mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, display_name, email, password_hash) VALUES (#{username}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{passwordHash})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET display_name = #{displayName}, username = #{username}, bio = #{bio}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET icon_image_path = #{iconImagePath}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = #{email})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = #{username})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = #{username} AND id <> #{selfId})
